tex_content.html:
Lemma
[The comparison kernel solves the heat equation]

↗ def:comparison-kernel

\group Heat Equation

For $t<\tau $, \[ K_t-\Delta _xK=0. \]
Proof

\sketch Put $s=\tau -t$. Direct differentiation gives

\[ \Delta _xK=K\left(\frac{|x-y|^2}{4s^2}+\frac n{2s}\right) =-\partial _sK=K_t. \]

□
